name: 白腰草鷸
illustrationTaxon: Tringa ochropus, monotypic: 21-24 cm, slightly larger and longer-winged than Wood Sandpiper. Upperparts rather dark with relatively discreet whitish marks compared with Wood Sandpiper, the chest slightly darker and with a clear-cut border with the white belly. There is a fairly broad supercilium that does not extend behind the eye, the bill is medium-length and has a paler basal half, and the legs are greenish. Ageing is tricky: juveniles have duller wing coverts and tertials with small contrasting buff spots along the edge that form a narrow buff subterminal bar across the width of the feather, and the white bars on the central tail feathers are narrower, more irregular and buffish compared with adults. When flushed it flies off showing dark upper and underwings, a white rump with broad bars on the tail (which often looks all-dark) and white underparts, distinguishing it from Wood Sandpiper apart from the call.

similarSpecies.distinction: 林鷸背上密佈明顯的白色斑點、眉紋又長又闊且延伸到眼後，腿細長、趾間距大，翼下淺色；本種背部深褐而只帶細碎白點，眉紋在眼後就中斷，翼下深色。
磯鷸體型更小、腿短呈黃綠色，翼與褐背之間有一塊尖長白楔，尾長伸出翼尖且不停上下擺尾；本種腿較長呈暗綠灰，尾上與腰白色、飛行時與深色翼強烈對比。

featureNotes: 嘴長度中等，基部一半明顯較淡、末端深色，這點與林鷸的深色嘴不同（第1圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
眉紋相當闊，但在眼的後方就中斷、不延伸到後腦——HKBWS 特別點出這一點，可以與眉紋長長延伸的林鷸分開（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
背部與翼上偏深褐近黑，只散佈細小的淡色點斑；相比之下林鷸背上的白點密而明顯（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
胸部灰褐、與白色的腹部之間有一道乾淨利落的分界線，不像林鷸那樣糊成一片（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive read: Category I, an uncommon passage migrant and winter visitor, rare in summer, occurring in a wide variety of freshwater wetlands; 21-24 cm, slightly larger and longer-winged than Wood Sandpiper, with rather dark upperparts bearing relatively discreet whitish marks compared with Wood Sandpiper, a slightly darker chest with a clear-cut border with the white belly, a fairly broad supercilium that does not extend behind the eye, a medium-length bill with a paler basal half and greenish legs; ageing is tricky, juveniles having duller wing coverts and tertials with small contrasting buff spots along the edge forming a narrow buff subterminal bar across the width of the feather, and narrower, more irregular and buffish white bars on the central tail feathers than adults; when flushed it flies off showing dark upper and underwing, a white rump with broad bars on the tail which often looks all-dark, and white underparts, distinguishing it from Wood Sandpiper in addition to the call; voice a loud high-pitched ringing multi-syllabic call when flushed and a repeated plip plip plip alarm call; most records are from the brackish fish pond areas around Deep Bay but it is regular in freshwater wetlands elsewhere including channelised and natural watercourses both small and large, wet and mixed wet and dry agriculture and freshwater marsh, occurring at low densities everywhere and always in lowland areas, and is rare in intertidal areas except in freshwater channels running through the mangrove or onto the mudflat; away from the mainland New Territories there are very few records, with eight from Po Toi spread more or less evenly across the winter period from August to April, one from Peng Chau and one of migrants over the sea south of Hong Kong on 7 April 2018; monthly waterbird counts in the Deep Bay area since 1979 show numbers lowest in June and gradually rising to a peak in January with March still higher, indicating migrants pass through at this time, before declining through April and May; the highest count is 130 on 19 March 2017 and the highest single-site count away from Deep Bay is 28 at Kam Tin, and Sung et al. (2021) concluded from winter waterbird counts that the wintering population in Deep Bay declined from 1998 to 2017; single birds are often encountered at the water's edge or walking through shallow water, calling loudly during an often zig-zagging flight before alighting some distance away when flushed; monotypic, breeding across the Palearctic from Scandinavia east to northeast Siberia and south to northern Kazakhstan and Mongolia largely between 45N and the Arctic Circle, and wintering in western and southeast Europe, north and sub-Saharan Africa, the Middle East and the Indian subcontinent east to south China and south to southeast Asia and Borneo; in China breeding in the northwest and northeast and wintering southeast of a line from Beijing to western Yunnan; IUCN Least Concern with an increasing population trend.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對中長而基部較淡的嘴、止於眼後的闊眉紋、暗褐背部與細白點、胸口與白腹的清晰分界；單型種。
兩隻比較鳥均為 AI 生成示意（林鷸、磯鷸，均沿用 0163 已核對素材），非等比例；卡上不作完整鑑別檢索表。
HKBWS 指出年齡鑑定困難：幼鳥翼覆羽與三級飛羽較暗淡、邊緣有淡黃色小點形成橫斑，中央尾羽白斑較窄且偏淡黃；這些屬手上觀察的特徵，卡上不作圓圈。
飛行時腰與尾上覆羽白色、與深色翼及翼下強烈對比，是與林鷸分開的重點——站立圖拍不到，只寫在文字與比較鳥的說明裡。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地與越冬地不分工。
IUCN 無危 LC（**趨勢上升**，是本批少見的上升種）；香港屬 Category I，不常見過境鳥兼冬候鳥、夏季罕見；最高 130 隻（2017-03-19）。
